dip_buy.label: Dip-Buy
dip_buy.method: block-bootstrap CI excludes 0; OOS train/test confirmed (+0.71/+0.98)
dip_buy.note: healthy>SMA200 + oversold(-5%/3d) + market-down(SPY -1.5%/3d); exit -3/+3 sell-half/trail/20d. Market-down filter ~doubles EV vs control.

earnings_drift.label: Earnings Drift
earnings_drift.note: pre-earnings drift; buy ~10d before earnings, sell day before. Strongest per-trade EV but blowout filter adds only ~+0.19%/trade over generic drift (+0.70). Needs block-bootstrap.

dip_refined.label: Dip-Buy (profile-filtered)
dip_refined.note: dip_buy + require_profile_support (HVN support / below value area). Higher EV, ~62% fewer setups; inherits dip's validation but the profile filter itself is not separately significance-tested.

session_node_spy.label: Session-Node Reversion
session_node_spy.note: No robust edge. /ES profile mean-reversion rejected 4 ways (naive MR, daily swing vs beta, per-year robustness, true 1-min anchor); the prior-session anchor adds no alpha over long-beta. Kept as a propose-only exploratory signal, not a backtested edge.
